description: SR2026 CBPR+ pacs.004 Payment Return validation rules. Used to return funds from a previously settled pacs.008 or pacs.009 payment. One transaction per message. Replaces MT103 RETN and MT202 RETN.
replacedMT: MT103 RETN / MT202 RETN / MT205 RETN

keyFacts.purpose: Return funds for a previously settled payment (pacs.008 or pacs.009)
keyFacts.correlationKey: OrgnlUETR links return to original pacs.008 or pacs.009
keyFacts.returnChain: Mandatory — identifies roles of parties in the return
keyFacts.returnReason: Mandatory — must use ISO 20022 return reason codes (e.g. DUPL, CUST, TECH)

bizSvc.message: Business Service identifier is wrong for pacs.004 Payment Return.
bizSvc.hint: pacs.004 uses swift.cbprplus.05. Do not use pacs.008 (swift.cbprplus.02) or pacs.009 values.

msgDefIdr.fix: Change Message Definition Identifier to pacs.004.001.09.

bizMsgIdr.fix: Enter a Business Message ID in AppHdr (maximum 35 characters).
bizMsgIdr.hint: Must match the Group Header Message ID.

bizMsgIdrFormat.message: Business Message ID contains invalid characters or exceeds 35 characters.
bizMsgIdrFormat.fix: Use only FIN-X characters and keep the value within 35 characters.

creDt.message: BAH Creation Date is missing or does not include a UTC timezone offset.
creDt.fix: Enter a valid Creation Date-Time with a UTC offset. Example: 2026-11-15T09:30:00+00:00
creDt.hint: Plain dates without a timezone offset are rejected.

from.fix: Enter the sending institution BIC in the AppHdr From field.
from.hint: Must match the Instructing Agent BIC in the Group Header.

to.fix: Enter the receiving institution BIC in the AppHdr To field.
to.hint: Must match the Instructed Agent BIC in the Group Header.

copyDuplicate.message: Copy/Duplicate indicator is not allowed in pacs.004.
copyDuplicate.fix: Remove the Copy/Duplicate (CpyDplct) element from AppHdr.

bizMsgIdrEqualsMsgId.message: Business Message ID and Group Header Message ID do not match.
bizMsgIdrEqualsMsgId.fix: Ensure Business Message ID and Group Header Message ID are identical.
bizMsgIdrEqualsMsgId.hint: Both fields must contain the same unique reference value.

fromBicMatchesInstgAgt.message: BAH From BIC does not match the Instructing Agent BIC.
fromBicMatchesInstgAgt.fix: Use the same BIC for the BAH From field and the Group Header Instructing Agent.
fromBicMatchesInstgAgt.hint: 8-character BICs are automatically padded to 11 by appending XXX.

toBicMatchesInstdAgt.message: BAH To BIC does not match the Instructed Agent BIC.
toBicMatchesInstdAgt.fix: Use the same BIC for the BAH To field and the Group Header Instructed Agent.

documentNamespace.message: Document XML namespace is wrong or missing.
documentNamespace.fix: Use the correct pacs.004.001.09 document namespace.

appHdrNamespace.message: AppHdr XML namespace is wrong or missing.

MsgId.message: Group Header Message ID is missing.
MsgId.fix: Enter a unique Message ID in the Group Header (maximum 35 characters).
MsgId.hint: Must match the Business Message ID in AppHdr.

CreDtTm.message: Group Header Creation Date-Time is missing or lacks a UTC offset.
CreDtTm.fix: Enter a valid Creation Date-Time with a UTC offset. Example: 2026-11-15T09:30:00+00:00

NbOfTxs.message: Number of Transactions must be 1. pacs.004 carries exactly one return per message.
NbOfTxs.hint: CBPR+ allows only one transaction per pacs.004 message.

SttlmInf_SttlmMtd.message: Settlement Method is missing or contains an invalid value for pacs.004.
SttlmInf_SttlmMtd.fix: Set Settlement Method to INDA or INGA.
SttlmInf_SttlmMtd.hint: INDA = Instructed Agent settles. INGA = Instructing Agent settles. CLRG is not permitted in CBPR+.

InstgAgt_BICFI.message: Group Header Instructing Agent BIC is missing.
InstgAgt_BICFI.fix: Enter the Instructing Agent BIC in the Group Header. Must match the BAH From BIC.

InstdAgt_BICFI.message: Group Header Instructed Agent BIC is missing.
InstdAgt_BICFI.fix: Enter the Instructed Agent BIC in the Group Header. Must match the BAH To BIC.

RtrId.fix: Enter a unique Return ID to identify this return transaction (maximum 35 characters).
RtrId.hint: This is a new reference for the return message, not the original payment reference.

OrgnlGrpInf.message: Original Group Information is not provided.
OrgnlGrpInf.fix: Include the Original Group Information block with original Message ID and creation date to aid reconciliation.
OrgnlGrpInf.hint: Optional per XSD (minOccurs=0) but strongly recommended so the receiving bank can identify the original payment.

OrgnlGrpInf_OrgnlMsgId.message: Original Message ID is missing from Original Group Information.
OrgnlGrpInf_OrgnlMsgId.fix: Enter the Message ID from the original pacs.008 or pacs.009 that is being returned.
OrgnlGrpInf_OrgnlMsgId.hint: This enables the receiving bank to identify and match the original payment.
OrgnlGrpInf_OrgnlMsgId.condition: Mandatory when OrgnlGrpInf block is included

OrgnlGrpInf_OrgnlMsgNmId.message: Original Message Name Identifier is missing or invalid.
OrgnlGrpInf_OrgnlMsgNmId.fix: Set Original Message Name to pacs.008.001.08 (returning a customer payment) or pacs.009.001.08 (returning an FI payment).
OrgnlGrpInf_OrgnlMsgNmId.hint: pacs.008.001.08 for customer credit transfers; pacs.009.001.08 for FI credit transfers; pacs.009.001.08COV for cover payments.
OrgnlGrpInf_OrgnlMsgNmId.condition: Mandatory when OrgnlGrpInf block is included

OrgnlInstrId.message: Original Instruction ID is not provided.
OrgnlInstrId.fix: Include the Original Instruction ID from the original pacs.008 or pacs.009 for matching and reconciliation.
OrgnlInstrId.hint: Optional per XSD (minOccurs=0) but strongly recommended to enable matching with the original payment.

OrgnlEndToEndId.fix: Enter the End-to-End ID from the original pacs.008 or pacs.009 payment.
OrgnlEndToEndId.hint: Required when the original payment was a pacs.008 or pacs.009 COV.

OrgnlUETR.message: Original UETR is missing or not a valid lowercase UUID v4.
OrgnlUETR.fix: Enter the UETR from the original pacs.008 or pacs.009 payment. Use lowercase UUID v4 format.
OrgnlUETR.hint: This is the primary correlation key linking the return to the original payment.

RtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt.message: Returned Interbank Settlement Amount is missing.
RtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt.fix: Enter the amount being returned with a valid ISO 4217 currency code. Example: 10000.00 USD
RtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt.hint: Must be greater than zero. Maximum 14 total digits, 5 decimal places.

RtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt_Ccy.message: Returned Settlement Amount currency code is missing.
RtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt_Ccy.fix: Add a valid ISO 4217 currency code to the Returned Amount. Example: USD, EUR, GBP

IntrBkSttlmDt.fix: Enter a valid Settlement Date in YYYY-MM-DD format without any timezone. Example: 2026-11-15
IntrBkSttlmDt.hint: This is the settlement date for the return, not the original payment date.

RtrnChain.fix: Add the Return Chain block to identify the roles of parties in the return transaction.
RtrnChain.hint: The Return Chain reverses the original payment chain. It is mandatory in pacs.004.

RtrChain_Assgnr.message: Return Chain Assignor (the party sending the return) is missing.
RtrChain_Assgnr.fix: Enter the Assignor — the institution initiating the return (BIC preferred).
RtrChain_Assgnr.hint: The Assignor is typically the bank that originally received the payment and is now returning it.

RtrChain_Assgne.message: Return Chain Assignee (the party receiving the return) is missing.
RtrChain_Assgne.fix: Enter the Assignee — the institution receiving the return (BIC preferred).

RtrRsnInf.fix: Add a Return Reason block with a valid ISO 20022 return reason code.
RtrRsnInf.hint: Free text reason codes are not allowed in CBPR+. Use official ISO codes.

RtrRsnInf_Rsn_Cd.message: Return Reason code is missing or not a valid ISO 20022 code.
RtrRsnInf_Rsn_Cd.fix: Enter a valid return reason code. Common codes: DUPL (duplicate), CUST (customer request), TECH (technical issue), FRAD (fraud), LEGL (legal decision), NARR (use AddtlInf for free text).
RtrRsnInf_Rsn_Cd.hint: Free text in the reason code field is not permitted in CBPR+. Use ExternalReturnReason1Code values.

RtrdInstdAmt.fix: Enter the original instructed amount being returned with a valid ISO 4217 currency code. Example: 10000.00 USD
RtrdInstdAmt.hint: This is the amount originally instructed by the originator, which may differ from the interbank settlement amount if charges were applied.

ChrgBr.message: Charge Bearer is missing or contains an invalid value for pacs.004.
ChrgBr.fix: Set Charge Bearer to CRED or SHAR.
ChrgBr.hint: CRED = charges borne by the creditor (receiver of return). SHAR = charges shared. DEBT and SLEV are not applicable in return messages.

TxInf_InstgAgt.message: Transaction Instructing Agent BIC is missing.
TxInf_InstgAgt.fix: Enter the Instructing Agent BIC in the transaction block. This is the institution sending the return.
TxInf_InstgAgt.hint: Must be a valid ISO 9362 BIC (8 or 11 characters).

TxInf_InstdAgt.message: Transaction Instructed Agent BIC is missing.
TxInf_InstdAgt.fix: Enter the Instructed Agent BIC in the transaction block. This is the institution receiving the return.
TxInf_InstdAgt.hint: Must be a valid ISO 9362 BIC (8 or 11 characters).

originalTxRef.description: Original Transaction Reference — optional block but mandatory fields when included. Carries key data from the original payment for reconciliation.
originalTxRef.note: The Original Transaction Reference section is optional. When included, its contents must match the original payment data unchanged.

OrgnlTxRef_IntrBkSttlmDt.message: Original Settlement Date is not included in Original Transaction Reference.
OrgnlTxRef_IntrBkSttlmDt.fix: Provide the original Interbank Settlement Date when including Original Transaction Reference.
OrgnlTxRef_IntrBkSttlmDt.hint: Recommended for reconciliation. Must match the original payment exactly.

OrgnlTxRef_Amt.message: Original Amount is not included in Original Transaction Reference.
OrgnlTxRef_Amt.fix: Provide the original instructed or settlement amount for reconciliation.
OrgnlTxRef_Amt.hint: Recommended when the beneficiary needs to reconcile the return against the original.

returnReasonCodes.description: Valid ISO 20022 ExternalReturnReason1Code values for CBPR+ pacs.004.

commonCodes.description: Duplicate payment — this transaction is a duplicate of an already processed payment.
Customer request — the ordering customer has requested cancellation/return.
Underpayment — the amount received was less than expected.
Overpayment — the amount received was more than expected.
Technical problem — return due to a technical issue at the returning bank.
Fraudulent origin — the original payment was fraudulent.
Legal decision — return ordered by a court or legal authority.
No account — the beneficiary account does not exist.
Agent decision — the agent has decided to return the payment.
Narrative — use AddtlInf for free text reason when no specific code applies.
Incorrect account number — account number format is invalid.
Closed account — the account has been closed.
Blocked account — the account is blocked.
Wrong amount — the amount received does not match the instructed amount.
Missing creditor address — creditor postal address is required but missing.

returnReasonCodes.forbidden: Free text codes not in the ISO ExternalReturnReason1Code list are NOT allowed under CBPR+.

uetr.message: UETR is not a valid UUID v4 or contains uppercase letters.
uetr.fix: Enter a valid lowercase UUID v4 value. Example: 4a1a0945-5772-409a-83ba-240e666e0267
uetr.hint: XSD UUIDv4Identifier only accepts lowercase [a-f0-9]. Uppercase letters are rejected.

date.message: A date field contains a timezone offset, which is not allowed.
date.fix: Enter all dates in YYYY-MM-DD format without any timezone suffix.

amount.message: Amount is zero, negative, or exceeds the maximum allowed precision.
amount.fix: Enter a positive amount with a maximum of 14 total digits and 5 decimal places.

currency.message: Currency code is not a valid ISO 4217 active currency code.
currency.fix: Enter a valid 3-letter ISO 4217 active currency code. Example: USD, EUR, GBP

bic.fix: Enter a valid 8 or 11-character BIC. Example: BANKUS33 or BANKUS33XXX
bic.hint: Format: 4 institution + 2 country + 2 location + optional 3 branch code.

addressRules.description: SR2026: TwnNm and Ctry are mandatory in all postal addresses. Fully unstructured addresses (AdrLine only) are rejected.

TwnNm.message: Town/City is missing from a Postal Address.
TwnNm.fix: Enter the Town or City in the postal address.
TwnNm.hint: Required in all addresses since SR2026.

Ctry.message: Country is missing or contains an invalid code.
Ctry.fix: Enter a valid 2-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Example: GB, US, DE

adrLineDeprecated.message: Unstructured address (AdrLine only) is no longer accepted in SR2026.
adrLineDeprecated.fix: Replace unstructured address lines with structured fields: Street Name, Building Number, Postal Code, Town, Country.
adrLineDeprecated.hint: Up to 2 AdrLine elements are still allowed alongside TwnNm and Ctry (hybrid format).

repositoryValidationRules.description: Cross-message rules that require the original payment message. Cannot be validated from the pacs.004 alone.
repositoryValidationRules.correlationKey: OrgnlUETR = UETR of the original pacs.008 or pacs.009

rules.message: The original payment referenced by OrgnlUETR was not found in the message repository.
rules.fix: Verify the Original UETR matches a settled pacs.008 or pacs.009 in the payment repository.

rules.message: Original Instruction ID does not match the Instruction ID of the original payment.
rules.fix: Check the Original Instruction ID against the original pacs.008 or pacs.009 InstrId.

rules.message: Original End-to-End ID does not match the End-to-End ID of the original payment.
rules.fix: Check the Original End-to-End ID against the original pacs.008 or pacs.009 EndToEndId.

rules.message: Returned amount exceeds the original settlement amount.
rules.fix: Ensure the Returned Interbank Settlement Amount does not exceed the original IntrBkSttlmAmt.

rules.message: A return for this Original UETR has already been processed.
rules.fix: Verify this is not a duplicate return. Check the payment repository for existing returns on this UETR.

rules.message: This Message ID has already been used by this sender.
rules.fix: Use a new unique Message ID. Duplicate IDs within 90 days are rejected.

validationLayers.description: 3-layer validation. Stop if a layer fails.
validationLayers.failFastStrategy: Layer 1 fail → skip Layers 2 and 3. Layer 2 fail → skip Layer 3.

Layer1_XSD.failAction: REJECT — skip all business rule validation

Layer2_StandardXML.description: Business rules from a single XML instance.

Layer3_Repository.description: Cross-message rules requiring original payment lookup.
Layer3_Repository.failAction: REJECT or ALERT per operational policy

xmlGenerationRules.description: Default values for generating SR2026-compliant pacs.004 XML.

changesSinceSR2025.description: Key SR2026 changes affecting pacs.004 CBPR+

changes.impact: Breaking — all postal addresses must include Town and Country

changes.sr2026: Fully deprecated as standalone — ERROR if AdrLine present without TwnNm + Ctry
changes.impact: Breaking — migrate addresses to structured or hybrid format
Must include UTC timezone offset e.g. +00:00
Replace free text with valid ISO reason codes

corrections: Fix 1 — OrgnlGrpInf: mandatory=true → mandatory=false, recommended=true, severity WARNING. XSD: minOccurs=0.
Fix 1b — OrgnlGrpInf_OrgnlMsgId and OrgnlGrpInf_OrgnlMsgNmId: mandatory=false, presence=CONDITIONAL.
Fix 2 — OrgnlInstrId: mandatory=true → mandatory=false, recommended=true, severity WARNING. XSD: minOccurs=0.
Fix 3a — RtrdInstdAmt added: mandatory=true, totalDigits=14, fractionDigits=5.
Fix 3b — ChrgBr added: mandatory=true, allowedValues=[CRED, SHAR].
Fix 4 — OrgnlMsgNmId.allowedValues: added pacs.009.001.08COV for cover payment returns.
Fix 5 — Removed 1 duplicate NARR entry from returnReasonCodes.commonCodes.
